Definition: to solidify (as if by refining); also to spring (as if separating the limbs)
BiblicalUsage: Pazaz means to be strong and agile, to leap, to spring. Jacob says in Genesis 49:24 that Joseph's arms are made strong by the hands of the mighty God of Jacob. Michal sees David leaping and dancing before the Lord in 2 Samuel 6:16, and despises him in her heart.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that strength that leaps before the Lord is strength given by God, and the same leaping that Michal despised is the worship David would not give up.
RelatedPeople: Joseph, Son of Jacob; King David
